Package io.jstach.rainbowgum.jfr

@NullMarked package io.jstach.rainbowgum.jfr
A LogOutput backed by JDK Flight Recorder (JFR), inspired by JFRLog.

The Service Loaded configurator adds this output to the output registry with URI scheme "jfr".

    Class
    Description
    JfrAlertListener
    A LogAlerts.Listener that commits each alert as its own RainbowGumAlertEvent - deliberately a separate JFR event type family from JfrLogOutput's RainbowGumLogEvent, even though the shape (per-level split, same fields) and rendering are the same; see RainbowGumAlertEvent for why sharing one event type between alerts and application log lines was rejected.
    JfrAlertListenerBuilder
    Builder to create JfrAlertListener.
    JfrAlertListenerConfigurator
    Registers a JfrAlertListener with LogAlerts if "logging.jfr.alerts.enabled" is true.
    JfrConfigurator
    Adds JfrLogOutput to the output registry with URI scheme "jfr".
    JfrLogOutput
    A LogOutput that commits each log event as a JFR event (see RainbowGumLogEvent) instead of writing anywhere.
    RainbowGumAlertEvent
    Base JFR event committed by JfrAlertListener, one concrete subclass per SLF4J / System.Logger.Level, deliberately a separate JFR event type family from RainbowGumLogEvent (same field shape and per-level split, but its own @Names) even though both are committed the same way and carry the same fields: an alert (an appender failing to write, an async publisher's queue overflowing, etc.) is not an application log line, and merging the two under one event name would make it impossible to tell them apart in a recording - e.g. filtering jfr print --events io.jstach.rainbowgum.Error would return both genuine application errors and RainbowGum's own internal alerts with no way to distinguish them.
    RainbowGumAlertEvent.DebugEvent
    DEBUG level alert.
    RainbowGumAlertEvent.ErrorEvent
    ERROR level alert.
    RainbowGumAlertEvent.InfoEvent
    INFO level alert.
    RainbowGumAlertEvent.TraceEvent
    TRACE level alert.
    RainbowGumAlertEvent.WarnEvent
    WARN level alert.
    RainbowGumLogEvent
    Base JFR event committed by JfrLogOutput, one concrete subclass per SLF4J / System.Logger.Level, so each level can be independently enabled/disabled and thresholded through a Flight Recorder configuration (.jfc) the same way any other JFR event type can.
